name: thoughts
description: Free, open-source, local-first Markdown notes for Windows x64. No Thoughts account or additional runtime.
long_description: Local stdio MCP for Claude Desktop, Claude Code and Codex using the same Windows-user Thoughts library by default, regardless of installation order. Keep the advanced home setting on auto unless deliberately selecting a separate library. Notes and images stay on disk; only content explicitly requested by your AI host is returned to that host. Connecting does not initialize or open a library. Unsigned preview: Windows may block it; do not disable protection. Host and clean-Windows acceptance remain pending.

thoughts_home.title: Shared Thoughts home (advanced)
thoughts_home.description: Keep auto to share the Windows account's Thoughts folder with Codex and Claude Code. Only enter a different absolute local home when intentionally selecting another library. Existing data is never automatically migrated or merged.
